Autumn a simple notice for passengers
With that in mind

Travelers using the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways should send any pet travel details early so we can prepare the right care from booking through pickup. This notice is for anyone bringing a companion animal on a flight between skyports, and it covers the routine steps that help us keep each journey calm and orderly.

Our welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs with care, including carrier fit, rest needs, feeding notes, and any handling concerns that may affect the trip. Clear and prompt communication helps the desk match the plan to the journey, and it also helps the team respond quickly if travel plans change. Please keep documents ready, follow the guidance given at check-in, and share any updates as soon as you can.

If you are meeting a traveler with a pet at arrival, please wait for the desk direction before collecting the animal. This helps protect safety, reduce confusion, and keep the handover smooth for everyone involved. We appreciate respectful communication at each stage, because it allows the team to support both passengers and animals with steady attention.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk for any travel support or care update.
